name: Station alarm acknowledgement return path
aliases: substations Substation automation and command interfaces
summary: Carries acknowledgement from the assigned operator interface to its alarm-processing function.
description: Carries acknowledgement from the assigned operator interface to its alarm-processing function. Station automation collects measurements and statuses and issues assigned commands through defined authority paths. A communicated point has a value, quality and equipment identity; it should not be treated as an unexplained contact.

In a substation control building, the station controller receives bay information and forwards an operator's selected command to the correct bay device. Device feedback confirms whether the intended result actually occurred. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Operator acknowledgement” at the input and “Alarm-processing acknowledgement” at the output. Acknowledgement does not clear the physical cause.
